tests.result: Reproduced partial coworker persistence on storage failure, orphan survives reload and blocks same-name retry. Isolated browser only; all non-static requests blocked.

defects.title: Failed coworker creation leaves a persisted orphan and blocks retry
defects.repro: In an isolated workspace, create a coworker while localStorage writes to aven-polished-chats-v1 fail after preferences save. Reload, then retry the same name.
defects.expected: A failed creation either rolls back all coworker/chat/document state or provides a recoverable partial operation. The same name remains retryable.
defects.actual: UI says Could not save this coworker locally. Preferences still contain the coworker, but its chat and documents are absent. After reload it is absent from the sidebar and same-name retry says Choose a different name.

overrides.evidenceLevel: Fresh isolated browser failure/reload test + live welcome inspection
overrides.finding: Local welcome is correctly labeled, but failed creation persists an orphan coworker without its conversation/documents and blocks retry after reload.
overrides.nextAction: Make preferences/chat/doc creation transactional and add failure/reload/retry regression coverage.
overrides.limitation: Failure injected in isolated localStorage; no user data or provider/device calls.

overrides.finding: At least one recovery flow fails: coworker creation reports storage failure yet leaves persisted partial state that prevents same-name retry.
overrides.nextAction: Fix transactional creation/retry, then cover offline, timeout, cancellation and provider failure independently.
overrides.limitation: This finding proves a specific recoverability defect, not that all error paths fail.
